mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_device_switch_face_verification ( face_verify_token, user_id, partner_user_id, request_id, device_no, liveness_id, liveness_result, liveness_sequence_id, baseline_type, baseline_face_encrypted_ref, candidate_face_encrypted_ref, similarity, status, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{faceVerifyToken}, #{userId}, #{partnerUserId}, #{requestId}, #{deviceNo}, #{livenessId}, #{livenessResult}, #{livenessSequenceId}, #{baselineType}, #{baselineFaceEncryptedRef}, #{candidateFaceEncryptedRef}, #{similarity}, #{status}, #{expiresAt, typeHandler=com.pk.infra.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, face_verify_token, user_id, partner_user_id, request_id, device_no, liveness_id, baseline_type, similarity, status, expires_at, consumed_at FROM user_device_switch_face_verification WHERE face_verify_token = #{faceVerifyToken} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, face_verify_token, user_id, partner_user_id, request_id, device_no, liveness_id, baseline_type, similarity, status, expires_at, consumed_at FROM user_device_switch_face_verification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'VERIFIED_PENDING' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
